planets.name: HAT-P-9 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Tevel with a 3.92-day year, found in 2008.

text.card: HAT-P-9 b was found in 2008 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Tevel. Its orbit and size follow Wang et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname WANG_ET_AL__2019): disc_year 2008, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.92281131, pl_radj 1.393, pl_bmassj 0.749

quotes.title: HAT-P-9b
quotes.card: HAT-P-9b, formally named Alef, is an exoplanet approximately 1500 light years away in the constellation Auriga.
quotes.introduction: This planet was found by the transit method on June 26, 2008.
